elements.quote: A review of studies and survey reports published over the last decade suggests that there is a steady rise in non-communicable diseases (NCDs) burden in low-income countries (LICs), including Pakistan. ... the problem has been underestimated in Pakistan because of scarcity of relevant data and lack of focussed policy in place.
elements.reason: Describes the current state of knowledge (rise in NCDs/obesity) and uncertainties (scarcity of data, underestimated problem).

elements.quote: To date, fewer studies in published literature have focussed on examining in depth the socio-demographic, environmental, lifestyle and dietary patterns and other factors contributing to nutrition transition in Pakistan mainly in the women of reproductive years. This review article was planned to highlight the nutrition transition in Pakistan...
elements.reason: Explains the importance and need for the review by highlighting the scarcity of focused studies on Pakistani women and the intent to address this gap.
The manuscript does not explicitly identify or cite a similar systematic review to justify the current review as an update or replication.
